items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Oh, I think, uh, Fats Wilder and James B. Johnson, they impressed me more than any musician at that time.

ctx.x: Don't play the blues. knows that Oliver Elkhorn lives or is still living. Everybody is theorizing about Oliver Elkhorn. Yes, he made some records in the past, but nobody cares about his whereabouts. No, that's right. And he told me I was the first person to interview him, and that's really funny. There are some jazz experts living here in Chicago, but they don't care about their music. Yeah, it's really funny. And as I told you, I only heard from you by him. That's right. And of course I know your composition.…
